newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey sells 198.1 trln lira of 2-yr bonds.
newsitem.headline: Turkey sells 198.1 trln lira of 2-yr bonds.

text.p: The Turkish Treasury sold 198.1 trillion lira of two-year inflation-indexed bonds at 32 percent risk premium on Tuesday, up sharply from 55.3 trillion lira sale and 29.95 percent risk premium in the previous May 13 auction.
There will be three-month coupon (interest) payments on the bonds.
Banks will pay 196.1 trillion lira to the Treasury for the auction on Wednesday when the Treasury faces a 288.2 trillion lira of bond redemption.
